Delegation Of Financial/ administrative powers in case of retired employees of EPFO and / or
their spouse/ dependents.
Sir,
The Executive Committee, Central Board of Trustees, EPF in its 100th meeting held on 18-11-
2021  has  approved the  delegation  of financial /  administrative  powers  in  case  or  indoor  medical
treatment taken  by the  retired  employees of EPFO and / or their spouse / dependents as  under
